target_doc: oblast massed-strike day D (Kyiv calendar day): missiles >= 7 or strike drones >= 20 in the oblast (FPV excluded), max over the OVA summary and LLM-extracted strike events (view oblast_daily_gt). The extractor's reading volume no longer makes negatives. Otherwise unknown
